question.text: By when must a Cat III AIF submit its Compliance Test Report (CTR) to the Sponsor and Trustee?

answer.text: Within 30 days from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular dated June 19, 2014, the Investment Manager must submit the CTR within 30 days from the end of the financial year to the Sponsor/Trustee. **The Trap:** 15/60 day timelines are incorrect; CTR is annual, not quarterly. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same CTR cadence applies across AIF categories. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Prepare a live CTR checklist updated quarterly so the April–May submission is stress-free.
